cannot_claim: measured TE from one/few ribo-seq datasets; condition-specific; still not causal
id_mapping_method: Exact join from BioReality protein_id suffix 511145.<b-number> to RefSeq CDS locus_tag b-number; coverage is summed over the matching CDS genomic interval and strand.
source_kind: GEO processed pooled ribosome-profiling wiggle coverage
study_ref: Li, Burkhardt, Gross, and Weissman 2014 Cell, GSE53767, random-fragment control pooled footprint and mRNA wig files
te_definition: mean CDS footprint wiggle coverage on the annotated coding strand divided by mean CDS mRNA wiggle coverage on the same strand; CDS intervals and b-number joins come from the existing RefSeq NC_000913.3 BioReality CDS file
